matrix_note: bounded smoke matrix authored by WO-L0-WORKSHOP-INTENT-TEST-MATRIX-RUNNER-01; exercises the runner over the FRAME-D shim with cases drawn from RK-060 closure precedents plus clean / no-route / bare-ambiguity / kind-order anchors; this matrix is NOT the parser-quality corpus and is NOT a benchmark; corpus design and corpus authoring are reserved for follow-up packets

cases.prompt_text: Configure GitHub Actions to deploy a Node.js app to Azure.
cases.rationale: Clean single-workflow anchor: object.workflow plus domain.deployment yields a clean B with no ambiguity and a single workflow_file kind.

cases.prompt_text: Create a code review skill for my repository.
cases.rationale: Skill intent anchor: action.create plus object.skill plus domain.code_review yields C with the skill kind; ambiguity is flagged because multiple distinct_target_objects fire.

cases.prompt_text: What year did the Apollo program land on the moon?
cases.rationale: No-signal no-route anchor: prompt fires no FRAME-B family at all; FRAME-C falls to H via the no-candidate, no-out-of-scope, no-repo-meta path; surfaces are the default no-forced-selection literals.
Out-of-scope no-route anchor: out_of_scope.general_world fires on weather, triggering H with the explicit prompt_out_of_repo_scope rejection surface.

Default bare-ambiguity anchor: action-only signal set with no informative target / domain / output_shape / constraint triggers the FRAME-C bare-ambiguity rule and emits the default kinds tuple (skill, instruction, workflow_file).

RK-059 closure precedent: action.assist family added by WO-L0-WORKSHOP-FRAME-B-COVERAGE-01 (DC-076) ensures `help with my project` reaches the bare-ambiguity rule and surfaces G with the default bare-ambiguity kinds tuple.
Turkish-alias precedent: the action.assist family's tr_aliases include `yardim` and `yardim et`; FRAME-A's U+0131 pre-fold rule is exercised end-to-end via the FRAME-D shim.

cases.prompt_text: Set up scheduled dependency scanning every Monday.
cases.rationale: RK-060 residual (a) closure precedent: the bounded `scheduled` canonical on object.hook plus constraint.event_triggered (DC-080) AND the FRAME-C category-selector branch mapping {workflow_file, hook} under high ambiguity to B (DC-081) together deliver the planning intent B/[workflow_file, hook].

cases.prompt_text: Add instructions for setting up CI on a new Python repo.
cases.rationale: RK-060 residual (b) closure precedent: the bounded `setting up` / `sets up` canonicals on action.set_up (DC-079) make the gerund inflection match under the existing short_token_1 budget; FRAME-C workflow_file co-fires alongside instruction and the workshop category becomes E.

cases.prompt_text: Improve the way we handle code reviews.
cases.rationale: RK-060 residual (c) closure precedent: the vague improve-plus-code-review ambiguity rule (DC-081) appends `instruction` and `agent` candidates alongside the already-firing `skill` candidate when primary_action == improve AND domain.code_review fires AND no informative target_object is present.

RK-060 residual (d) closure precedent: the deploy-variant bare-ambiguity emission tuple (DC-081) replaces the default kinds tuple when primary_action == deploy (e.g., `release` matches action.deploy); the result is G/[workflow_file, instruction, cookbook_entry].

RK-060 residual (e) closure precedent: WO-L0-WORKSHOP-FRAME-B-COVERAGE-02A added a source-safe assembled product-name canonical to FRAME-B repo_meta_near_miss.repo_navigation (DC-078) so the original W-PRM-025 text reaches I via FRAME-C without adding the forbidden contiguous external-integration substring to FRAME-B source.

cases.prompt_text: Explain how this repo is organized.
cases.rationale: RK-060 residual (f) closure precedent: the bounded sibling word-order canonical `how this repo is organized` added to FRAME-B repo_meta_near_miss.repo_navigation (DC-078) makes the original W-PRM-026 text reach I via FRAME-C under the existing strict-position matching rule.

cases.prompt_text: Define an agent that runs a test workflow on demand.

tolerated_variants.rationale: FRAME-C synthesis ordering precedent: emission order is rule-driven and may differ from planning-doc order; both [agent, workflow_file] and [workflow_file, agent] are accepted as semantically equivalent matches for this precedent case.

cases.rationale: Kind-order tolerated-variant precedent (W-PRM-014 lineage): the planning intent expects [agent, workflow_file] but FRAME-C emits in shape-touch-rule order; the tolerated_variants entry accepts the reverse ordering so the comparator treats both as a match.

Ambiguity-expectation anchor: action.create (from `make`) with no informative target / domain / constraint triggers bare-ambiguity; the default kinds tuple is preserved because primary_action is not `deploy`.
